title: PropertiesPanel text field advanced options (multiline, word wrap, instance name)
description:
The TextView section in PropertiesPanel (packages/authoring-ui/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx lines 922-1058) exposes Font, Size, Bold, Italic, Color, Align, and Type — but the TextDisplayObject data model also carries multiline, wordWrap, underline, letterSpacing, scrollable, and instanceName fields that have no authoring UI at all.

Gap: switching a text field to 'dynamic' or 'input' type should unlock extra options (multiline toggle, word wrap toggle, max chars, variable/instance name) that Flash 8 shows in the Properties panel. Without instanceName there is no way to target the field from AS2 (_root.scoreText.text = ...) through the UI (agents can set it via script_set/stage_update, but not via the panel).

Work items:
1. Add a Multiline toggle button (visible for dynamic/input type) that toggles obj.multiline.
2. Add a Word Wrap toggle button (enabled only when multiline is true) that toggles obj.wordWrap.
3. Add an Underline toggle button (B/I/U row) that toggles obj.underline.
4. Add a Var / Instance Name text input that reads/writes obj.instanceName (show for dynamic/input text).
5. Add a Letter Spacing numeric field (optional, nice-to-have) for obj.letterSpacing.
6. Wire the Scrollable checkbox for dynamic text.

No new model fields are needed — all properties already exist in TextDisplayObject in packages/core/src/engine/types.ts.

Acceptance: the PropertiesPanel for a dynamic text field shows multiline, word wrap, and instance name controls. Setting instanceName via the panel and publishing a SWF makes _root.<name>.text = 'hello' resolve correctly in Ruffle (reuse the test harness from task 0519).
